sources.note: owned by barnes and noble - disabled for now (not indie)

sources.name: The Bookies
sources.note: BookManager platform; events come from its JSON API, read via a headless page session.

sources.name: Little Blue Pigeon Books
sources.note: Wix Events calendar API (per-month); months = how many months ahead to fetch.

sources.name: Douglas County Libraries
sources.note: Communico RSS feed (auto-detected); already per-event, so no detail crawl.

sources.name: Aurora Public Library
sources.note: LibCal/libnet RSS feed; already per-event, so no detail crawl.

sources.name: Denver Public Library Friends
sources.note: WordPress The Events Calendar REST API (wp-json/tribe/events/v1).

sources.name: Eventbrite (Denver books)
sources.note: Scrapes Eventbrite's public Denver 'books' search (their event search API was retired). Headless.

sources.name: Burning Through Pages
sources.note: WordPress The Events Calendar REST API.

sources.name: Read Queen Bookstore
sources.note: WordPress The Events Calendar REST API.

sources.name: The Romance Section
sources.note: Eventbrite organizer page -> per-event JSON-LD. Their site uses an Eventbrite import plugin.

sources.name: Spicy Librarian / Romance Discovery
sources.note: Eventbrite organizer page (provided org id) -> per-event JSON-LD.

sources.name: Matter Bookstore
sources.note: WordPress; events listed in page text (no Tribe API/feed). Heuristic only — its links point to unrelated pages, so skip the detail stage.

sources.name: Edgewater Books
sources.note: WordPress; events listed in page text. Heuristic only; skip detail stage.

sources.name: Good Girl Cafe & Bookstore
sources.locationName: Good Girl Cafe & Bookstore, Denver, CO
sources.note: Square Online (editmysite) site; events live in window.__BOOTSTRAP_STATE__ as page-builder 'repeatables' (Quill rich text). The squareonline extractor renders the page and parses those; dates are embedded in the body text ('October 7th | 6pm').

sources.name: Haven Coffee & Books
sources.note: seems like all events are old 2026 - WordPress; events are server-rendered in the page HTML as 'Month Day, Year: Title …' entries (no Tribe API). Heuristic over the page text; skip the detail stage (links point elsewhere).

sources.name: Denver Book Swap Society
sources.note: Eventbrite organizer page -> per-event JSON-LD (same pattern as The Romance Section).

sources.name: Spell Books
sources.note: Squarespace Scheduling / Acuity. The acuity extractor establishes a session from the schedule page, reads appointment types from its HTML, and queries /availability/times per type for scheduled dates. owner/slug/calendarId from the booking embed.

sources.name: Arapahoe Libraries
sources.note: BiblioCommons gateway JSON API (RSS feed has no dates). ~10 events/page; pages caps how many to read.

sources.name: Boulder Public Library
sources.note: LibNet/Communico RSS feed (same family as DCL/Aurora).

sources.name: High Plains Library District
sources.note: LibCal RSS feed (from the hpld calendar). Date/time parsed from the item description.

sources.name: Annual festivals (manual)
sources.note: Hand-maintained once-a-year events (book festivals, conventions). Edit config/static-events.json.
